subject: Satellite Health — Premium Onboarding + Custom Data Integration (escalation)
messages:
From: Emily Jones <emily.jones@satellite-health.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@satellite-health.com
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood intro — scope / pricing question

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo this week. Satellite Health is excited about Redwood — the latency profiles and multiregion routing look promising for our telehealth workflows. We're preparing a purchase request but have two things that need to be covered before procurement can move forward:

1) Premium onboarding: We need vendor-managed onboarding (hands-on, up to 160 hrs) including custom connector to our EHR export and a week of runbook pairing during first month.
2) Commercial: The finance team is asking for a bundled price that includes a 30% term discount for an annual commitment and waived onboarding invoice until after go-live.

I've attached a draft SOW from our side with integration details (SOW-Satellite-Integration-v3.pdf). Can Redwood confirm whether the above can be packaged in a single purchase order, and if not, what approvals are required?

Target cadence: procurement wants a signed SOW by 6/25. Any chance we can get an answer this week?

Best,
Emily
Emily Jones
Director of IT Procurement
Satellite Health
emily.jones@satellite-health.com

Attachments: SOW-Satellite-Integration-v3.pdf

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Emily Jones <emily.jones@satellite-health.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood intro — scope / pricing question

Hi Emily — great to hear, and appreciate the SOW. I'm copying Karthik (sales lead) and Marissa (account exec) so we can move quickly.

Short answer: we can cover the technical onboarding + connector work, but the commercial ask (30% bundled discount + deferred onboarding invoice) is outside standard pricing and will need deal desk / exec signoff.

Action items:
- Karthik: can you confirm recommended commercial proposal (term, discount, credits) and whether Legal needs special terms for the deferred billing?
- Marissa: I think we should propose a single SOW with two line items (product + services) and a single signature, but with the onboarding invoice marked as "deferred" and tied to a 60-day milestone.

Emily, I'll push this up for expedited review. If you can confirm the PO window (do you need net-30 or net-60?) that will help.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 08:26:00 -07:00
Subject: FWD: Satellite Health — premium onboarding + discount request (deal desk)

Team — forwarding Emily's SOW and Sofia's note. Quick summary:
- ACV (base product): $420k/year for the requested throughput and regions
- Standard onboarding: 80 hrs (we bill $24k). Customer requests 160 hrs + custom EHR connector (~$48k services).
- Commercial ask: 30% discount on ACV and deferred onboarding invoice until after go-live.
- Strategic context: reference account in the Midwest, multi-region pilot planned; high expansion potential (payer integrations).

Recommendation: Approve a 20% discount on first-year ACV if we bundle the 160hr onboarding as a one-time professional services line (no discounted rate on services). For the deferred invoicing, suggest a compromise: we can accept a 30-day deferred invoice for onboarding (invoice at go-live + 30d) but require a 50% nonrefundable onboarding deposit at signature to cover initial resource allocation.

Questions for execs:
- Approve up to 20% first-year ACV discount (higher discount would need CRO signoff).
- Approve the invoice deferral as described (30 days post-go-live + 50% deposit).

This is time-sensitive — procurement needs SOW signed by 6/25. Requesting review and signoff today so Marissa can update contract.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Director, Sales

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 10:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FWD: Satellite Health — premium onboarding + discount request (deal desk)

Karthik / team — thanks for the clear recommendation. I'm willing to approve the 20% first-year ACV discount under the following conditions:

1) Onboarding must be contracted as a separate professional services line at the standard rate (no discount on services).
2) 50% onboarding deposit is collected at signature and held against the deferred invoice. If customer fails to pay the deferred invoice, we retain the deposit.
3) Limit the one-time concession to Year 1; future years revert to list pricing unless explicit renewal discount approved by Deal Desk.
4) Add a short addendum to the SOW clarifying support scope during the first 90 days and an exit criteria signoff for the connector handover.

Marcus — flagging you for visibility on the revenue recognition and any tax/finance implications from the deferred invoice.

If Marcus has no objections, this is green to go.

Rishi
VP, Deal Desk & Commercial Operations

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 13:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FWD: Satellite Health — premium onboarding + discount request (deal desk)

All — quick finance note: deferred invoicing is acceptable under revenue guidelines provided we book a contract liability and collect the 50% deposit at signature. Confirm language that deposit is nonrefundable and applied against services invoice. Also confirm that any billed prepaid services are recognized over service delivery period per ASC guidance. No blocking issues from my side.

Marcus Lin
Head of Finance Operations

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Emily Jones <emily.jones@satellite-health.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Approved: Satellite Health SOW + commercial terms (next steps)

Emily — quick update and next steps.

Thank you for the SOW and patience while we reviewed internally. The following has been approved by Deal Desk and Finance:

- Commercial: 20% discount on first-year ACV (applied to product line only).
- Services: 160 hrs onboarding (standard services rate, no discount).
- Billing: 50% nonrefundable onboarding deposit due at signature; remaining onboarding invoice deferred to 30 days after go-live.
- Contracting: Single SOW with two line items (Product ACV + Professional Services). We will append an addendum clarifying 90-day success metrics and handover criteria for the connector.

Next steps:
1) Marissa will update the SOW & contract with the approved terms and route for signature (DocuSign link will be shared).
2) We will require the 50% deposit at signature to secure onboarding resources.
3) Go-live milestone definition: successful data ingest and two production-week stability window.

Marissa — please send the updated SOW and DocuSign link (use the HubSpot deal above). Emily — if that timeline works for procurement, we can target signature by 6/24 to meet your internal deadline.

Best,
Sofia
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-pricing-summary.xlsx
